output_text:
from datadog_api_client import ApiClient, Configuration
from datadog_api_client.v2.api.metrics_api import MetricsApi
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.query_metrics_payload import QueryMetricsPayload
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.query_metrics_request import QueryMetricsRequest
from datetime import datetime

def compare_metric_series(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    configuration = Configuration()
    # Assumes DD_API_KEY and DD_APP_KEY are set as environment variables
    api_client = ApiClient(configuration)
    metrics_api = MetricsApi(api_client)

    # Convert ISO 8601 timestamps to Unix epoch seconds
    from_ts = int(datetime.fromisoformat(payload["from_time"]).timestamp())
    to_ts = int(datetime.fromisoformat(payload["to_time"]).timestamp())

    # Build queries for the two series to compare
    aggregator = payload.get("aggregator", "avg")
    query1 = f"{aggregator}:{payload['metric_name']}{{{payload['filter1']}}}"
    query2 = f"{aggregator}:{payload['metric_name']}{{{payload['filter2']}}}"

    body = QueryMetricsPayload(
        data=QueryMetricsRequest(
            _from=from_ts,
            to=to_ts,
            queries=[
                {
                    "data_source": "metrics",
                    "name": "series1",
                    "query": query1,
                },
                {
                    "data_source": "metrics",
                    "name": "series2",
                    "query": query2,
                },
            ],
        )
    )
    result = metrics_api.query_metrics(body=body).to_dict()
    return result
